SELECT delivered.id AS workitemId, delivered.title AS title, delivered.delivered_at AS deliveredAt, delivered.delivery_started_at AS deliveryStartedAt FROM ( SELECT w.id AS id, w.title AS title, (SELECT MAX(e.gmt_create) FROM workitem_event e JOIN status_node done_node ON done_node.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND done_node.template_id = w.template_id AND done_node.code = e.to_val AND done_node.category = 'DONE' WHERE e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.workitem_id = w.id AND e.event_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE') AS delivered_at, (SELECT MIN(d.gmt_create) FROM dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND d.workitem_id = w.id AND d.is_deleted = 0
) AS delivery_started_at FROM workitem w JOIN status_node sn ON sn.id = w.status_node_id AND sn.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.work_type = 'REQ' AND sn.category = 'DONE' ) delivered WHERE delivered.delivered_at >= #{start} AND delivered.delivered_at < #{end} ORDER BY delivered.delivered_at, delivered.id
